fields.Project Description:
AdProof AI is a visual evidence workspace for small brands reviewing advertising claims. Upload a creative and supplied product facts, inspect claims in Claim X-Ray, trace quotations and findings in Proof Constellation, repair evidenced image problems, then compare the revision independently with Muse Spark. Claim DNA tracks observed changes without treating a missing claim as proof of removal. The original and revised pixels remain inspectable.

The existing production Studio includes 12 style options, seven consistency locks, Social Media/Website/Print output controls, actual PNG size and interpolation disclosures, local recovery, JSON/ZIP evidence export and explicit saved-audit continuation. Verification can block a revised export; AI scores are estimates, not certification. Dated live evidence includes ARUNA claim repair, NORI styles, Website 1600x900/1920x1080 and A4 output. The style evidence also preserves a typography false-positive and its follow-up fix/testing status.

App: https://adproof-ai.vercel.app/app
Public recorded example: https://adproof-ai.vercel.app/app?example=aruna
Documentation: https://adproof-ai.vercel.app/docs
Video: https://adproof-ai.vercel.app/demo.html

The public example contains genuine saved production reports and pixels from a fictional QA product. Opening it makes no model request or automatic approval. New paid Meta requests require private Judge Access. No credential is published.
fields.Describe your use of Meta products to bu:
Muse Spark 1.3 performs multimodal claim audits, source-text localization where needed, and separate original-versus-revision comparisons. Muse Image 1.0 edits source creatives, applies deliberately selected styles, and adapts composition to a new aspect ratio. Source-pixel/OCR repair and local output rendering are distinguished from model generation. Reports record the model, available response IDs, timestamps and input/output hashes; application provenance is not presented as a signed provider receipt.

Muse Code made genuine retained contributions to the Studio and claim engine. Evidence is public in issue #9/run 40497541084/commit 963e543 and issue #14/run 40552300687/commit 91eb887. Subsequent ChatGPT integration, review and fixes are attributed separately. Actual production report/image evidence is in the repository under evidence/live-2026-11-01 and evidence/styles-2026-11-01.
fields.Why are Meta's models important to your: The work depends on reading a visual advertisement in context, distinguishing the advertisement's own wording from supplied product facts, editing actual image pixels, and checking the revision against its original. Spark supplies structured visual reasoning and a separate comparison; Muse Image supplies the source-referenced image edit. Keeping those stages independent lets the application preserve uncertainty and block a result that fails its guards instead of accepting a higher score alone. Model output is fallible: the repository records failed cases, manual inspection and fixes as well as successful outputs.
